theorems.name: Submission.any_radius_tilt_height_l1
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen U → ∀ (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ), V.HasGeneralizedMeanCurvature H → ∀ (z : Amb n ℓ) (r h : ℝ), 0 < r → 0 ≤ h → closedBall z r ⊆ U → ∀ T : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ), Module.finrank ℝ T = n → (∀ x ∈ V.support ∩ closedBall z r, infDist (x - z) (T : Set (Amb n ℓ)) ≤ h) → ∫ x in closedBall z (r / 2), hsNormSq (V.tangentProj x - T.starProjection) ∂V.weight ≤ 144 * (r ^ 2)⁻¹ * ∫ x in closedBall z r, infDist (x - z) (T : Set (Amb n ℓ)) ^ 2 ∂V.weight + 4 * h * ∫ x in closedBall z r, ‖H x‖ ∂V.weight
